hints.text: Check vowels against a set containing standard vowel characters a, e, i, o, u in lowercase and uppercase.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Scan the string from the last character toward the start, advancing while the current character is a vowel.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Slice the string up to the first non-vowel index encountered from the right.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def trimTrailingVowels(s: str) -> str:
    vowels = set("aeiouAEIOU")
    idx = len(s) - 1
    while idx >= 0 and s[idx] in vowels:
        idx -= 1
    return s[:idx + 1]
```
